name: gnark-playground-circom
description: Circom/Circomkit workspace for generating proofs to aggregate in gnark recursion

scripts.compile: circomkit compile mul_a && circomkit compile mul_b
scripts.setup: circomkit setup mul_a && circomkit setup mul_b
scripts.prove: circomkit prove mul_a default && circomkit prove mul_b default
scripts.verify: circomkit verify mul_a default && circomkit verify mul_b default
scripts.all: npm run compile && npm run setup && npm run prove && npm run verify
